user.title: P4 Doorbell
user.description: Select the ESPHome caller and 1–3 VoIP Stack browser phones. Camera and player can be independent HA entities. Call state must belong to the caller.

data.camera: Door camera (including an independent IP camera)
data.player: Media player audible at the door

reply.title: Prerecorded reply
reply.description: Choose a file from HA local media, for example: We cannot open the door right now. This reply does not automatically start recording.

reconfigure.title: Change camera and player
reconfigure.description: Caller, receivers and recorder stay unchanged. Finish calls and pending messages first. The player must support HA media and report playback start and completion for recording prompts.

error.door_entities: Select an existing camera and player. During setup the call-state sensor must belong to the caller.
error.receiver_count: Select one to three distinct phones.
error.local_media: Select a file from Home Assistant local media.
error.busy: Finish the call, recording or pending message first. The integration must be loaded.

abort.single_instance_allowed: A doorbell is already configured. Open its sidebar panel.

init.title: P4 prompt and voice message
init.description: Select the P4 recorder entities and a prompt. Button mode waits up to 60 seconds after the prompt; a press while recording saves the message. The physical sensor can be omitted for a panel-only test.

data.auto_after_timeout: Offer and record a message after an unanswered call
data.wait_for_button: Wait for a bell press after the prompt
data.visitor_sensor: P4: Physical bell button sensor (optional for testing)

error.busy: Finish the call and cancel pending messages in the doorbell panel first.
error.door_entities: All recorder entities must belong to P4. Record and cancel buttons must differ.
error.local_media: Select a file from My media (HA local media).
error.save_required: Select the stop-and-save button for button mode.
